title: Repertoire analysis of mice producing fully human antibody with lambda light chain
description: This project is the data from the analysis of H chain and lambda L chain repatoires of fully human antibody-producing mice (IGHL mice). This project includes data on repertore analysis of unimmunized IGHL mice and immunized IGHL mice with the receptor binding domain (RBD) of SAR-CoV-2 spike protein.
